description: This file defines the Matrix class for managing matrix data structures, including creation, validation, slicing, and basic operations, as part of a mathematical library.

classes.name: Matrix
classes.description: A class representing a mathematical matrix with various methods for matrix operations, validation, and data management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a new Matrix instance from a 2D array of values and builds internal grid.

methods.name: buildFromArray
methods.description: Initializes the matrix grid from a nested array, setting the number of rows and columns.

methods.name: validateRow
methods.description: Validates that a row index is a positive integer.

methods.name: validateColumn
methods.description: Validates that a column index is a positive integer.

methods.name: validateRowInRange
methods.description: Ensures a row index is within the matrix's row range.

methods.name: validateColumnInRange
methods.description: Ensures a column index is within the matrix's column range.

methods.name: getRows
methods.description: Returns a subset of rows from the matrix as a new Matrix object.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Returns a subset of columns from the matrix as a new Matrix object.

methods.name: dropRows
methods.description: Returns a new matrix with specified rows removed.

methods.name: dropColumns
methods.description: Returns a new matrix with specified columns removed.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value at a specific row and column.

methods.name: rows
methods.description: Yields each row as a vector or value.

methods.name: columns
methods.description: Yields each column as a vector or value.

methods.name: isSquare
methods.description: Checks if the matrix is square.

methods.name: isVector
methods.description: Checks if the matrix is a vector (single row or column).

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the matrix into a 2D array.

methods.name: solve
methods.description: Solves the linear system A*X = B using LU or QR decomposition depending on whether the matrix is square.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Allows read-only access to certain properties like rows and columns.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Dynamically calls functions or operations on the matrix, such as transpose or inverse.
